sqlGroup.select: SELECT a.userid, a.name FROM wxwork_user a
SELECT a.userid, a.name, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM wxwork_user a left join wxwrk_rela_user_dept b on a.userid = b.userid where b.deptid =#{deptId}
sqlGroup.update: INSERT INTO wxwork_user ( userid, name, mobile, `position`, gender, email, avatar, thumb_avatar, telephone, alias, address, open_userid, main_department ) VALUES( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )
sqlGroup.delete: delete from wxwork_user where EXISTS (select * from wxwork_rela_user_dept where wxwork_rela_user_dept.userid=wxwork_user.userid and deptid=#{deptId})
